title: Technology Associate, Data Engineering
summary: 3+ years developing, optimizing, and modernizing enterprise ETL pipelines in a Cloudera Hadoop environment — from a config-driven PySpark framework to a legacy warehouse migration.
bullets: Developed and optimized 30+ ETL workflows implementing business logic, transformations, and validation rules across Informatica BDM, HiveQL, Impala SQL, PySpark, and shell scripting in Cloudera Hadoop
Modernized 15+ enterprise reporting datasets from a legacy warehouse platform to Hadoop-based workflows, preserving data consistency and downstream reporting reliability
Built and maintained a reusable config-driven PySpark ETL framework — dynamic configuration handling, validation and reconciliation logic, flexible batch processing
Led root-cause analysis and pipeline-level debugging across multi-stage ETL workflows, resolving data mismatches and production defects
Delivered end-to-end ETL and migration work independently — query conversion, workflow development, validation, UAT support, and deployment
Created and optimized daily, monthly, quarterly, and custom-date ETL workflows with configurable runtime parameters and partition-based loading logic
